title: gnaphalium cheiranthifolium f. citrinum
intro: Gnaphalium cheiranthifolium f. citrinum, commonly known as Lemon Gum Cudweed, is a subspecies of the Gnaphalium cheiranthifolium plant, a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used in medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating wounds, skin irritations, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Gnaphalium cheiranthifolium f. citrinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
